referenceFiles.role: immutable creature identity and Cinderwake actor rendering style
elevated world camera and apparent gameplay scale only

passed: exactly one creature and one pose
quiet idle rather than an action
torso is more raised than current production

failed.detail: Some top planes are visible, but the long head and torso still read primarily as a side profile rather than the 55-degree world camera.
The torso remains horizontally dominant and low; at runtime size the creature still reads closer to a crouched carcass than a compact raised predator.
All four limbs exist, but the two far-side limbs merge into the body/near-leg mass instead of preserving four clean negative-space channels.

The lowest visible support is concentrated under the right/front feet rather than straddling the fixed bottom-center actor anchor, so the apparent planted base would not align with the shared monster collision disc.
Bright plate highlights and a large orange shoulder core are glossier and louder than the restrained low-sheen Cinderwake material target.
The creature occupies roughly four-fifths of the raw canvas width, exceeding the requested 60-68 percent envelope and leaving insufficient horizontal padding.
The pink background is visibly graded rather than one flat literal #ff00ff value.

evaluation.notes: Pose-isolated generation successfully prevented row-semantic collapse, but this first master is not credible enough to seed per-pose generation. It remains too lateral, wide, glossy, orange-heavy, and visually prone.

preparation.notes: Uniform aspect-preserving placement fits the 236x224 safe box and exact foot anchor, but width becomes the limiting dimension: the prepared ink is 236x126 source pixels, only about 63 runtime pixels tall, with an aspect ratio near 1.87. Raster normalization cannot make the source compact without deforming anatomy.

recommendation: Stop after this one master. Do not generate the remaining idle phases or any actions from it. A later isolated master iteration must first correct camera, compactness, limb separation, material sheen, orange restraint, and raw framing.
